issuing_body: Minnesota Office of the Revisor of Statutes
title: 2026 Minnesota Laws, Chapter 127, Article 8, Section 6 — amendment to Minn. Stat. § 609.531, subd. 1
supports: The 2026 amendment to Minn. Stat. § 609.531, subd. 1 defines 'appropriate agency' for chapter 609 forfeiture and does not list the Minnesota Attorney General's Medicaid Fraud Control Unit.
The same amendment adds new Minn. Stat. § 609.467 medical assistance fraud to the definition of a 'designated offense' for chapter 609 forfeiture.
The statute separately defines 'prosecuting authority' as the attorney responsible for prosecuting the offense that is the basis for forfeiture.
selected_locators: Chapter 127, Article 8, Sec. 6, § 609.531 subd. 1(e) — appropriate agency
important_qualifications: The omission of MFCU from the 'appropriate agency' list supports a narrow conclusion about MFCU's own chapter 609 forfeiture role; it does not mean Minnesota law categorically forbids state asset seizure.
The 2026 Legislature simultaneously made medical assistance fraud a designated forfeiture offense, so publication must distinguish offense coverage from which agency may seize or hold property.
